title: Detailed television
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- TV body: retro wooden cabinet -->
  <rect x='8' y='20' width='84' height='58' rx='6' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='8' y='20' width='84' height='58' rx='6' fill='#a8702f' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- wood grain lighter streaks -->
  <rect x='10' y='24' width='80' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#c98a45'/>
  <rect x='10' y='70' width='80' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#c98a45'/>
  <!-- screen bezel -->
  <rect x='13' y='26' width='58' height='44' rx='4' fill='#3a2412'/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x='16' y='29' width='52' height='38' rx='3' fill='#2a6b8a'/>
  <!-- screen glow -->
  <rect x='19' y='32' width='34' height='20' rx='2' fill='#7fd4f0' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- picture on screen: sun and hills -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='38' r='5' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <path d='M16 62 Q28 48 40 60 Q50 50 68 62 Z' fill='#3fa86b'/>
  <path d='M16 62 Q26 54 36 62 Z' fill='#5ecb87'/>
  <!-- scanlines -->
  <rect x='16' y='29' width='52' height='2' fill='#1d4f68' opacity='0.6'/>
  <rect x='16' y='37' width='52' height='1.5' fill='#1d4f68' opacity='0.4'/>
  <rect x='16' y='46' width='52' height='1.5' fill='#1d4f68' opacity='0.4'/>
  <rect x='16' y='55' width='52' height='1.5' fill='#1d4f68' opacity='0.4'/>
  <rect x='16' y='64' width='52' height='1.5' fill='#1d4f68' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- control panel -->
  <rect x='74' y='28' width='14' height='40' rx='3' fill='#6b441f'/>
  <!-- knobs -->
  <circle cx='81' cy='37' r='4' fill='#c9c9c9'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='37' r='1.4' fill='#7a7a7a'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='50' r='4' fill='#c9c9c9'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='50' r='1.4' fill='#7a7a7a'/>
  <!-- speaker grille -->
  <rect x='76' y='58' width='10' height='8' rx='1.5' fill='#4a2f14'/>
  <rect x='77' y='59.5' width='8' height='1' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='77' y='61.5' width='8' height='1' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <rect x='77' y='63.5' width='8' height='1' fill='#8b5a2b'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='18' y='78' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#6b441f'/>
  <rect x='77' y='78' width='5' height='10' rx='2' fill='#6b441f'/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <rect x='48' y='8' width='3' height='13' rx='1.5' fill='#b3b3b3'/>
  <circle cx='49.5' cy='7' r='3' fill='#e05555'/>
  <circle cx='48.7' cy='6.2' r='1' fill='#ff9a9a'/>
</svg>
